/trends/analyze?flow=EXPORT&freq=M&start.seasonality_summary: A moderate repeating yearly pattern: Oct is typically the highest point (much higher than usual), Aug the lowest (much lower than usual).

/insights/events?start=1999.label: CETA applied
/insights/events?start=1999.title: EU-Canada trade agreement (CETA) provisionally applied
/insights/events?start=1999.description: Most of the Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement between the EU and Canada applies provisionally, removing tariffs on most goods.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: US steel tariffs
/insights/events?start=1999.title: US Section 232 tariffs on EU steel and aluminium
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The United States applies tariffs of 25% on steel and 10% on aluminium imported from the EU, until the tariff-rate quota deal of January 2022.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: EU rebalancing duties
/insights/events?start=1999.title: EU rebalancing duties on US products
/insights/events?start=1999.description: In response to the US steel and aluminium tariffs, the EU applies additional duties on a list of US products (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2018/886).

/insights/events?start=1999.label: EU steel safeguard
/insights/events?start=1999.title: EU safeguard measures on steel imports
/insights/events?start=1999.description: Provisional, then definitive, safeguard quotas on imports of steel products into the EU, to stop steel diverted from the US market.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: EU-Japan agreement
/insights/events?start=1999.title: EU-Japan Economic Partnership Agreement enters into force
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The EU-Japan Economic Partnership Agreement removes most tariffs on trade between the EU and Japan.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: Brexit
/insights/events?start=1999.title: The United Kingdom leaves the EU; transition period
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The UK leaves the EU under the Withdrawal Agreement. EU rules on trade keep applying until the end of the transition period on 31 December 2020.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: COVID-19
/insights/events?start=1999.title: WHO declares COVID-19 a pandemic
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The World Health Organization characterises COVID-19 as a pandemic. Lockdowns across Europe follow within days, and trade falls sharply in the second quarter of 2020.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: Luxembourg lockdown
/insights/events?start=1999.title: Luxembourg COVID-19 lockdown and state of crisis
/insights/events?start=1999.description: Luxembourg closes non-essential shops and activities and declares a state of crisis, lifted on 24 June 2020.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: EU-UK trade agreement
/insights/events?start=1999.title: EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement applies
/insights/events?start=1999.description: After the transition period, trade with the UK runs under the Trade and Cooperation Agreement: no tariffs or quotas, but customs formalities and rules of origin.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: Suez Canal blocked
/insights/events?start=1999.title: The Ever Given blocks the Suez Canal
/insights/events?start=1999.description: A container ship runs aground in the Suez Canal and blocks it for six days, delaying shipping between Asia and Europe.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: US-EU steel truce
/insights/events?start=1999.title: US-EU tariff-rate quotas on steel and aluminium
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The US replaces the Section 232 tariffs on EU steel and aluminium with tariff-rate quotas, and the EU suspends its rebalancing duties.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: Sanctions on Russia
/insights/events?start=1999.title: Russia invades Ukraine; first EU sanctions packages
/insights/events?start=1999.description: Russia invades Ukraine. The EU adopts sanctions packages restricting trade with Russia, and energy and commodity prices jump.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: Gas price peak
/insights/events?start=1999.title: European gas price peak
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The European wholesale gas price reaches its highest level, raising the value of energy imports and the costs of energy-intensive industry.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: CBAM reporting
/insights/events?start=1999.title: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism: transitional period starts
/insights/events?start=1999.description: Importers of iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers and some chemicals start reporting the embedded emissions of their goods.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: Red Sea disruption
/insights/events?start=1999.title: Red Sea shipping disruption
/insights/events?start=1999.description: Attacks on ships in the Red Sea divert container traffic between Asia and Europe around the Cape of Good Hope, lengthening voyages and raising freight rates.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: EU duties on Chinese EVs
/insights/events?start=1999.title: EU countervailing duties on battery electric vehicles from China
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The EU imposes definitive countervailing duties on imports of new battery electric vehicles from China.

/insights/events?start=1999.label: US steel tariffs 2025
/insights/events?start=1999.title: US Section 232 tariffs of 25% on EU steel and aluminium
/insights/events?start=1999.description: The United States ends the tariff-rate quotas and applies 25% tariffs on steel and aluminium from all countries, the EU included.

backtest.summary: The ensemble of Holt-Winters and gradient boosting beats the seasonal naive forecast at every horizon tested: by 49% at 1 month, 53% at 3 months, 36% at 6 months, 3% at 12 months ahead.

scenarios.label: The smartphone line continues at its recent level

/insights/forecast?flow=EXPORT&freq=M&ho.caveat: The band is where 80% of the method's errors fell when it was tested on the past of this series (a conformal interval); tested that way, it held 81% of the actual months. It does not cover breaks the past does not show, such as a new tariff or a lost customer. In a backtest over 20 quarter ends it beat the seasonal naive forecast (the same month a year earlier) at 12 months ahead: a mean absolute percentage error of 9.8% against 9.9%. Since 2025-09 a single product line, the smartphone line (CN 8517 13 00), adds trade no model can foresee: the scenarios say what happens if it stops or continues. Months after 2025-12 are provisional and are revised by the source. Values are nominal euros.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: US steel tariffs
/insights/events?start=2021.title: US Section 232 tariffs on EU steel and aluminium
/insights/events?start=2021.description: The United States applies tariffs of 25% on steel and 10% on aluminium imported from the EU, until the tariff-rate quota deal of January 2022.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: EU-UK trade agreement
/insights/events?start=2021.title: EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement applies
/insights/events?start=2021.description: After the transition period, trade with the UK runs under the Trade and Cooperation Agreement: no tariffs or quotas, but customs formalities and rules of origin.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: Suez Canal blocked
/insights/events?start=2021.title: The Ever Given blocks the Suez Canal
/insights/events?start=2021.description: A container ship runs aground in the Suez Canal and blocks it for six days, delaying shipping between Asia and Europe.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: US-EU steel truce
/insights/events?start=2021.title: US-EU tariff-rate quotas on steel and aluminium
/insights/events?start=2021.description: The US replaces the Section 232 tariffs on EU steel and aluminium with tariff-rate quotas, and the EU suspends its rebalancing duties.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: Sanctions on Russia
/insights/events?start=2021.title: Russia invades Ukraine; first EU sanctions packages
/insights/events?start=2021.description: Russia invades Ukraine. The EU adopts sanctions packages restricting trade with Russia, and energy and commodity prices jump.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: Gas price peak
/insights/events?start=2021.title: European gas price peak
/insights/events?start=2021.description: The European wholesale gas price reaches its highest level, raising the value of energy imports and the costs of energy-intensive industry.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: CBAM reporting
/insights/events?start=2021.title: Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism: transitional period starts
/insights/events?start=2021.description: Importers of iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers and some chemicals start reporting the embedded emissions of their goods.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: Red Sea disruption
/insights/events?start=2021.title: Red Sea shipping disruption
/insights/events?start=2021.description: Attacks on ships in the Red Sea divert container traffic between Asia and Europe around the Cape of Good Hope, lengthening voyages and raising freight rates.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: EU duties on Chinese EVs
/insights/events?start=2021.title: EU countervailing duties on battery electric vehicles from China
/insights/events?start=2021.description: The EU imposes definitive countervailing duties on imports of new battery electric vehicles from China.

/insights/events?start=2021.label: US steel tariffs 2025
/insights/events?start=2021.title: US Section 232 tariffs of 25% on EU steel and aluminium
/insights/events?start=2021.description: The United States ends the tariff-rate quotas and applies 25% tariffs on steel and aluminium from all countries, the EU included.

/insights/forecast?flow=EXPORT&freq=M&ho.caveat: The band is where 80% of the method's errors fell when it was tested on the past of this series (a conformal interval); tested that way, it held 84% of the actual months. It does not cover breaks the past does not show, such as a new tariff or a lost customer. In a backtest over 20 quarter ends it did not beat the seasonal naive forecast (the same month a year earlier) at 12 months ahead: a mean absolute percentage error of 11.8% against 9.9%. It did beat it at 3 months ahead, with errors 34% smaller. Read the band as a range of plausible values, not as a prediction. Since 2025-09 a single product line, the smartphone line (CN 8517 13 00), adds trade no model can foresee: the scenarios say what happens if it stops or continues. Months after 2025-12 are provisional and are revised by the source. Values are nominal euros.
